sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 1000. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 200% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases buff limit for all stats by 120% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies buff removal resistance, preventing karma or any buff removal effect one time.
-Target: all allies. Applies Overcast for 60 seconds ([Special] increases max HP by 100%; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; increases all elemental defense by 60; recovers 50 Cost. After the effect ends, Time Extend activates and extends the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to yourself by 60 seconds for one time only.).
-Target: yourself. Applies Light Spirit's Crest for 120 seconds ([Heraldic] Increases max HP by 500%, increases all stats by 50%, increases light elemental attack for all allies by 40, enchants the attacks of all allies with a 25% Time Bane. Only one Heraldic effect may be active at a time (between both allies and enemies). When a new Heraldic effect is activated, the older effect will be removed. This effect is not affected by Time Slice or Time Extend).
-Target: yourself. Applies Ambush for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; reduces the cooldown time of Abilities to 0 (except for certain Abilities); nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 50000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).

[Investigation Team] Yu Narukami or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
